title: Portfolio sources manifest
description: Last-synced git fingerprints for each portfolio source repo. Written by `drift sync` (`scripts/check-drift.js`).

firstCommitProvisional.description: True while commitAnyRoot values are provisional estimates. Set to false after a real `drift sync`.

lastSyncedAt.description: ISO date of the last `drift sync` run (YYYY-MM-DD).

sources.description: Keyed by project slug (matches ProjectSlug in types.ts).

SyncedSource.description: Git fingerprint for one source repo. All fields optional — populated incrementally by check-drift.js. Property order matches FINGERPRINT_FIELDS in check-drift.js so Object.keys() derivation preserves field-drift display order.

commitHead.description: Short SHA of HEAD at last sync.

measuredRef.description: Git ref the fingerprint was measured against (resolved default branch, e.g. 'main', or 'HEAD' when no default branch could be resolved). Metadata only; excluded from drift comparison via DRIFT_SKIP_FIELDS.

commitsHuman.description: Commit count excluding non-human authors (CI bots, AI agents), lifetime. The denominator role inference divides by: `commits` counts bot commits as co-authorship, which reads solo work as a team project.

authorsDistinct.description: Distinct commit authors by email, all authors including bots.

authorsDistinctHuman.description: Distinct human commit authors by email. A value of 1 proves solo work regardless of commit share.

commitMeRoot.description: Whether Jason authored the repository's root commit: originated the project rather than joined it.

commitAnyLast.description: ISO date of the most recent commit.

commitMeLast.description: ISO date of Jason's most recent commit. Pairs with commitAnyRoot (also author-scoped) for a single-scope span.

commitAnyRoot.description: ISO date of Jason's earliest commit (his inception on the project), falling back to the repo root commit when he authored none.

spanMonthsActive.description: Distinct calendar months containing at least one Jason-authored commit. With spanMonthsAll, distinguishes sustained work from a burst followed by dormancy.

spanMonthsAll.description: Calendar months from Jason's first to last commit, inclusive.

spanGapMaxDays.description: Longest run of consecutive days with no Jason-authored commit, inside his own span. Makes intra-span dormancy detectable where the first/last endpoints alone cannot.

detectedLanguages.description: Languages present in the repo, ordered by file count. Advisory only — language tags are hand-curated.

linesAny.description: Total lines across tracked source files, all authors.

linesAnyAdded.description: Lines added by all authors, lifetime.

linesAnyRemoved.description: Lines removed by all authors, lifetime.

linesMeAddedRecent.description: Lines added by Jason, trailing 4 weeks.

linesMeRemovedRecent.description: Lines removed by Jason, trailing 4 weeks.

linesAnyAddedRecent.description: Lines added by all authors, trailing 4 weeks.

linesAnyRemovedRecent.description: Lines removed by all authors, trailing 4 weeks.

urlRepo.description: HTTPS URL of the primary git remote (git remote get-url origin), normalised from any SSH form. Used as the default repoUrl for un-authored projects.

urlsRepoCompanion.description: HTTPS URLs of companion repositories, in tracked topology order.

detectedRuntime.description: Runtime identity strings detected by the dependency-manifest parser (e.g. 'bun', 'deno', 'node', 'python', 'go'). Keys match RUNTIME_TAGS in tag-taxonomy.js.

detectedDatabase.description: Database package identities detected by the dependency-manifest parser (e.g. 'pg', '@supabase/supabase-js'). Keys match DATABASE_TAGS in tag-taxonomy.js.

detectedFramework.description: Framework package identities detected by the dependency-manifest parser (e.g. 'svelte', '@sveltejs/kit', 'react'). Keys match FRAMEWORK_TAGS in tag-taxonomy.js.

detectedTechFirstSeen.description: First-introduced date (YYYY-MM-DD) per detected tech identity, keyed by the same identity strings used in runtime/framework/database arrays (e.g. 'svelte-5', '@sveltejs/kit', 'bun'). Populated by a git pickaxe/file-add search against package.json, lockfiles and config files at drift sync time. Source-grep-only signals (e.g. inkjs when detected only via source import) are intentionally absent here and fall back to commitAnyRoot downstream. Excluded from drift comparison via DRIFT_SKIP_FIELDS (object identity would otherwise always read as drifted).
